description: This file defines the ShareProductTransactionHelper class, which includes static methods to create, retrieve, and update share products within the Apache Fineract project. It primarily handles REST API interactions related to share products, using utility methods for HTTP requests.

classes.name: ShareProductTransactionHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage share product transactions such as creation, retrieval, and update via REST API calls.

methods.name: createShareProduct
methods.description: Creates a new share product using a JSON payload and returns the resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveShareProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a share product by its ID, returning them as a map.

methods.name: updateShareProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing share product with provided provisioning criteria JSON.
